title: PHP error with a source path disclosed
description: The response body carries a error. PHP display_errors prints the message with the file path and line number, which reveals server layout.
remediation: Set display_errors to Off in production and log errors instead (display_errors = Off with log_errors = On).
limitation: Pattern on one body: a PHP message quoted in a bug report can match.

observation.body: Warning: Undefined variable $cart in /var/www/html/shop.php on line 14
Fatal error: Uncaught Exception in /var/www/app/index.php on line 12
